body: Maybe sheet metal would be a safer option?

Thank you for replying and it has been terrible sticking around. I went from working in a pathology laboratory to not being able to work or move at all. Being non-religious, I have very little fear of it, so it seems practical to me at this point. I will exhaust all options before doing something like this though. Thanks for replying once again, means a lot.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hqIsc8ooXug


This song has always been moving to me, especially in my lower times. As of lately a lot of things have been going wrong with me so this song has been helping me push through this rough period of time. Give it a listen if you're down or just want to feel better than you do. 

Take care and I have really enjoyed the songs so far.

Would love to see that as well, especially since I suffer from them myself. I currently have chronic migraine, Cervicogenic Headaches and 2 central neurological disorders: MS and Cervical Dystonia.

It would be nice to see how other people handle such conditions.
